explanation.heading: Why this was flagged
explanation.text: Cedar Analytics's DPA expired on 10 Mar 2026. Standard-tier vendors must hold a current DPA. The vendor record shows a data processing agreement that passed its end date, with no renewal recorded.

explanation.heading: Why it matters
explanation.text: A vendor is missing or holds an expired document required for its tier (critical: SOC 2, DPA, insurance; standard: DPA). Data processing agreements must be renewed before they expire, and the standard tier requires a current signed data processing agreement.
